title: Chat with Midori in the phone app
goal: The app carries the same conversation as Telegram, so replies and approvals can move from Telegram to the app
acceptance: The app sends and receives chat messages in the same conversation as Telegram
The conversation shows messages from both channels in order; the plan to retire Telegram-only replies is recorded
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, endpoints or personal data in Git.
validation: Every test reading live.js, dashboard.js or web/src
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: a conversation view, send path and shared history. Not a measurement; split when started if larger.
